verdict.rationale: Highnote's agentic-commerce solution page explicitly documents issuing cards per agent via API that close automatically when the workflow ends. Its controls include merchant category restrictions, per-transaction caps and velocity limits, all evaluated at authorization. The issuing docs back this with spend rules on MCC and dollar amount, velocity controls, and virtual card issuance. missing for 10: an in-depth first-party guide for the agent-card flow (the agent framing appears only on a solutions/marketing page), per-merchant locks beyond MCC-level restrictions, explicit time-based card expiry rather than workflow-end closure, independent or hands-on corroboration.
